sable.configuration.title: Sable Configuration
Whether sub-levels can split when parts are separated.
sable.configuration.sub_level_splitting_: Sub-level splitting heatmap steps that take place per tick.
sable.configuration.sub_level_tracking_r: The distance at which sub-levels are networked to players.
sable.configuration.sub_levels_with_play: Keeps sub-levels with intersecting players from unloading.
sable.configuration.sub_level_remove_min: The minimum Y coordinate sub-levels can exist at.
sable.configuration.sub_level_remove_max: The maximum Y coordinate sub-levels can exist at.
sable.configuration.sub_level_velocity_r: The fraction of velocity retained when a sub-level is loaded (0 = none, 1 = all).
sable.configuration.sub_level_punch_stre: The strength multiplier applied to sub-level punching impulses.
sable.configuration.sub_level_punch_down: The strength multiplier applied to the vertical component of downward sub-level punches.
sable.configuration.sub_level_punch_cool: The cooldown in ticks between sub-level punches.
sable.configuration.disable_udp_pipeline: Disables the entire Sable UDP networking pipeline. Better compatibility, but worse networking performance and latency.
sable.configuration.attempt_udp_networki: Whether Sable should attempt to send sub-level movement data over UDP.
sable.configuration.sub_level_saving_log: Whether to log when sub-levels are saved for a dimension.
sable.configuration.verbose_serializatio: Verbose logging for serialization and the holding chunk map. Debug only.
sable.configuration.sub_level_substeps_p: How many times the physics simulation is stepped each tick. Higher is more accurate but more expensive.
sable.configuration.sub_level_dynamic_sh: Whether sub-levels apply block shading dynamically.
sable.configuration.sub_level_water_occl: Whether sub-levels can occlude the water surface.
sable.configuration.sub_level_skylight_s: Whether sub-levels cast a shadow on the world.
sable.configuration.debug_draw_loaded_ch: Draw loaded chunks in the chunk debug renderer.
sable.configuration.sub_level_occlusion_: Cull sub-level sections hidden behind other sections, like vanilla's section occlusion graph.
sable.configuration.sub_level_cull_enclo: Skip sub-level blocks fully enclosed by opaque neighbours (the interior of solid structures).
sable.configuration.sub_level_batched_se: Draw sub-level sections in one batch per sub-level through the terrain pipeline. Much faster on large sub-levels; turn off to fall back to submitting every block individually.
sable.configuration.sub_level_render_dis: Maximum render distance (in blocks) for sub-levels. -1 disables distance culling.
sable.configuration.sub_level_snapshot_i: How far back, in game ticks, snapshot interpolation runs.
sable.configuration.sub_level_zoom_sensi: Zoom sensitivity for sub-level camera types.
